title: Foundation Master Bundle
description: Composed foundation governance bundle (v2 pillar structure; schema_version 2.0.0 pillars). Built deterministically from the 8 authoring pillars (frontmatter-rules + tagging-rules + naming-rules + mandatory-files-rules + doc-dependencies + file-type-contracts/*.json + vault-writers-rules + plans-rules) plus _index.json by tools/build-foundation-master.sh and committed at governance/foundation-master.json. Shipped as immutable artifact to adopter ~/.claude/governance/foundation-master.json; adopters never build. The runtime contract slots the hooks read (foundation-master.json#types == .frontmatter.types, #r32_type_aliases == .frontmatter.r32_type_aliases, #r32_exempt_paths, #r47_exempt_paths_composed, #r47_tag_cap, #tagging.taxonomy.dimension_prefixes) are declared per governance/_index.json cross_cutting rules-index. This validator is intentionally light: structural shape only; inner pillar content is governed by each pillar's own contracts. The v2 pillars carry the per-pillar rule register at `_rules[]` (NOT a legacy `rules[]` array); R-47's r47_exempt_paths source is tagging-rules.json#_rules[id=R-47].r47_exempt_paths, composed into r47_exempt_paths_composed per the pillar's own r47_exempt_paths_provenance. Repo-only schema; matches the v2 pillar structure.

bundle_version.description: sha256 of the canonical-serialized bundle content (excluding _meta block itself). Same source files -> same hash. Hook bundle-read path uses this for cache-invalidation.

source_file_mtimes.description: Map of source-file path -> ISO8601 UTC mtime. Hook bundle-read path may use this for staleness detection.

deterministic_serialization.description: Note declaring the serialization discipline used (e.g., 'jq -S sorted-keys canonical JSON')

frontmatter.description: Full governance/frontmatter-rules.json content (v2; carries types + tier_compliance + path_routing + retired_types + the _rules register). build-time composition may inject r32_type_aliases (.frontmatter.r32_type_aliases) when a gate-config source is present; absent by default (gate-config dropped) and the consumer falls back to // {}.

r32_type_aliases.description: Optional alias-type -> canonical-type map composed at build time when a gate-config source is present. Absent by default. Hooks read .frontmatter.r32_type_aliases // {}.

tagging.description: Full governance/tagging-rules.json content (v2 canonical taxonomy; R-47 r47_exempt_paths homed at _rules[id=R-47]).

file_type_contracts.description: Map of file-type-name -> contract object. Each key matches a file in governance/file-type-contracts/<name>.json (k8s paramKind pattern; matcher in mandatory-files-rules.json mandates.<file_type>).

vault_writers.description: Full governance/vault-writers-rules.json content (pillar 7). Carries pillar 7 fields daily_processing_root + writer_manifest_path + historical_data_warning_default.

plans.description: Full governance/plans-rules.json content (pillar 8). Covers plan-tree governance: root file mandates, plan-folder quartet, slug/subplan rules, backlog row contract, lifecycle status transitions.

_index.description: Full governance/_index.json content (pillar registry + cross-cutting meta-rules + dissolved_schemas registry).

r47_exempt_paths_composed.description: Deterministic union of R-47 exempt-paths composed from tagging-rules.json#_rules[id=R-47].r47_exempt_paths (v2 canonical declaration). Deduped + sorted for deterministic ordering. Consumed by pre-write-guard.sh R-47 advisory.

seed_taxonomy_exempt_paths_composed.description: Deterministic union of the DEDICATED tag-TAXONOMY exempt-paths composed from tagging-rules.json#_rules[id=R-47].seed_taxonomy_exempt_paths. SEPARATE from r47_exempt_paths_composed (the tag-PRESENCE list). Deduped + sorted. Consumed by skills/librarian/capabilities/frontmatter-enforce.sh tag-taxonomy arm to exempt the foundation-shipped vault-init seed surface (Vault Writers/_index.md) from the tag-not-in-taxonomy membership check without altering seed bytes.

r32_exempt_paths.description: R-32 type-check exempt globs. Composed from a gate-config source when present; empty by default (gate-config dropped). Consumer reads .r32_exempt_paths[]?.

r47_tag_cap.description: Per-file tag count cap; default 25 (no gate-config source).
